title: 文化漏斗：数据中缺失的文化无法对齐
summary: 本文提出LLM存在“文化数据漏斗”问题：预训练后文化信号急剧下降，地理集中、任务专精的数据占主导。多语言虽增强文化多样性但未保证平衡。发布含560万样本的文化标记数据集，可提升下游文化基准性能。
summary_en: This paper identifies a 'cultural data funnel' in LLM pipelines where cultural signals decline sharply after pretraining. Multilinguality helps geographic diversity but not balanced representation. A 5.6M culturally tagged dataset is released to improve downstream cultural benchmarks.
